examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi ài kànshū, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā liǎng běn Zhōngwén shū, nǐ ne?
examples.english: Youmei loves reading. I would like to give her two books in Chinese as a gift. How about you?

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī qiānbǐ.
examples.english: I have two pencils.

examples.chinese: 我們買兩枝，好不好？兩枝五十塊錢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen mǎi liǎng zhī, hǎo bù hǎo? Liǎng zhī wǔshí kuài qián.
examples.english: How about we buy two of them? Two for 50NT dollars.

examples.chinese: 我有一位英國老師和兩位日本老師。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yǒu yí wèi Yīngguó lǎoshī hé liǎng wèi Rìběn lǎoshī.
examples.english: I have one British teacher and two Japanese teachers.

examples.chinese: 這些東西一共兩萬三千五百零五塊。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē dōngxi yígòng liǎng wàn sān qiān wǔ bǎi líng wǔ kuài.
examples.english: These stuff cost twenty three thousand, five hundred and five dollars in total.

examples.english: My mom has an elder brother and two younger sisters.

examples.chinese: 我家附近有兩條捷運線。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā fùjìn yǒu liǎng tiáo jiéyùn xiàn.
examples.english: There are two MRT lines near my home.

examples.chinese: 李先生有三個孩子，一個兒子，兩個女兒。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiānshēng yǒu sān ge háizi, yí ge érzi, liǎng ge nǚ'ér.
examples.english: Mr. Li has three children: one son and two daughters.

examples.chinese: 我買了三個麵包，吃了兩個了，最後一個明天再吃。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎi le sān gè miànbāo, chī le liǎng gè le, zuìhòu yī gè míngtiān zài chī.
examples.english: I bought three breads, I have eaten two, I will eat the last one tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 我站了兩個小時了，好累！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhàn le liǎng gè xiǎoshí le, hǎo lèi!
examples.english: I have been standing for two hours, so tired!

examples.chinese: 帶這麼重的東西，走了兩個小時，我覺得很累。
examples.pinyin: Dài zhème zhòng de dōngxī, zǒu le liǎng ge xiǎoshí, wǒ juéde hěn lèi.
examples.english: Carrying such heavy things and walking for two hours, I feel very tired.

examples.chinese: 從中部坐車到南部去，差不多要兩個小時。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhōngbù zuò chē dào nánbù qù, chàbuduō yào liǎng gè xiǎoshí.
examples.english: Taking a bus from the central part to the southern part takes about two hours.

examples.chinese: 他喜歡玩手機遊戲，差不多每天玩兩個小時。
examples.pinyin: Tā xǐhuan wán shǒujī yóuxì, chàbuduō měitiān wán liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
examples.english: He likes to play mobile games, and plays for about two hours almost every day.

examples.chinese: 你回家經過賣韓國貨的超市時，可以順便幫我買兩包泡麵嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ huíjiā jīngguò mài Hánguó huò de chāoshì shí, kěyǐ shùnbiàn bāng wǒ mǎi liǎng bāo pàomiàn ma?
examples.english: When you pass by the supermarket that sells Korean merchandise on your way home, can you conveniently buy me two packs of instant noodles?

examples.chinese: 這兩部筆電的功能差異不大，就是價錢差了幾百塊。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng bù bǐdiàn de gōngnéng chāyì bú dà, jiùshì jiàqián chà le jǐ bǎi kuài.
examples.english: The functional difference between these two laptops is not big; it's just that the price differs by a few hundred dollars.

examples.chinese: 那兩家便利商店同樣提供客人休息的座位，但是第二家的空間比第一家大多了。林媽媽總是給她的雙胞胎女兒穿同樣顏色、同樣大小的衣服。
examples.pinyin: Nà liǎng jiā biànlì shāngdiàn tóngyàng tígōng kèrén xiūxi de zuòwèi, dànshì dì èr jiā de kōngjiān bǐ dì yī jiā dà duō le. Lín māma zǒngshì gěi tā de shuāngbāotāi nǚ'ér chuān tóngyàng yánsè, tóngyàng dàxiǎo de yīfu.
examples.english: Those two convenience stores similarly provide seats for customers to rest, but the second store's space is much larger than the first's. Mrs. Lin always dresses her twin daughters in clothes of the same color and the same size.

examples.chinese: 顏太太很會保養，母子兩人站在一起時，看起來就像一對姊弟。
examples.pinyin: Yán tàitai hěn huì bǎoyǎng, mǔzǐ liǎng rén zhàn zài yīqǐ shí, kàn qǐlái jiù xiàng yī duì zǐdì.
examples.english: Mrs. Yan is very good at maintaining her appearance; when the mother and son stand together, they look like a pair of siblings.

examples.chinese: 在這家餐廳吃飯，要是滿兩千元，老闆就免費招待一盤炒青菜。
examples.pinyin: Zài zhè jiā cāntīng chīfàn, yàoshi mǎn liǎngqiān yuán, lǎobǎn jiù miǎnfèi zhāodài yī pán chǎo qīngcài.
examples.english: If you spend at least two thousand dollars at this restaurant, the owner will treat you to a free plate of stir-fried greens.

examples.chinese: 珍珍每天大約看兩個小時的臺灣連續劇，目的是要(訓)練自己的中文聽力。大雄常利用週末練(習)書法，所以漢字寫得比其他同學都好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhēnzhēn měitiān dàyuē kàn liǎng ge xiǎoshí de Táiwān liánxùjù, mùdì shì yào xùnliàn zìjǐ de Zhōngwén tīnglì. Dàxióng cháng lìyòng zhōumò liànxí shūfǎ, suǒyǐ Hànzì xiě de bǐ qítā tóngxué dōu hǎokàn.
examples.english: Zhenzhen watches about two hours of Taiwanese TV dramas every day; her purpose is to train her Chinese listening comprehension. Daxiong often uses his weekends to practice calligraphy, so he writes Chinese characters more beautifully than any of his classmates.

examples.chinese: 小李進公司的頭三個月，每天上班要花兩個小時，後來搬到公司附近，走路十分鐘就到了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ jìn gōngsī de tóu sān ge yuè, měi tiān shàngbān yào huā liǎng ge xiǎoshí, hòulái bān dào gōngsī fùjìn, zǒulù shí fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
examples.english: For the first three months after Xiao Li joined the company, it took him two hours to commute every day; later he moved near the company, and it took only ten minutes to walk there.

examples.chinese: 我到德國留學的頭兩個星期，因為對環境不環境而迷過幾次路，後來就沒問題了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dào Déguó liúxué de tóu liǎng gè xīngqī, yīnwèi duì huánjìng bù shúxī ér mí guò jǐ cì lù, hòulái jiù méi wèntí le.
examples.english: In the first two weeks of studying in Germany, because I was not familiar with the environment, I got lost a few times; later there was no problem.

examples.chinese: 我往東走，你往西走，我們兩個的方向剛好相反。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ wǎng dōng zǒu, nǐ wǎng xī zǒu, wǒmen liǎng gè de fāngxiàng gānghǎo xiāngfǎn.
examples.english: I walk east, you walk west; our two directions are exactly opposite.

examples.chinese: 這個牌子的運動服在夜市賣五百元，可是在百貨公司賣兩千元，你覺得合理嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhège páizi de yùndòngfú zài yèshì mài wǔbǎi yuán, kěshì zài bǎihuò gōngsī mài liǎngqiān yuán, nǐ juéde hélǐ ma?
examples.english: This brand of sportswear sells for five hundred yuan at the night market, but sells for two thousand yuan at the department store—do you think that's reasonable?

examples.chinese: 這個保養品很適合皮膚乾的人，所以秋冬兩個季節銷售得非常好。因為店員的服務態度很好，所以這個專櫃的銷售成績是最好的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bǎoyǎngpǐn hěn shìhé pífū gān de rén, suǒyǐ qiū dōng liǎng ge jìjié xiāoshòu de fēicháng hǎo. Yīnwèi diànyuán de fúwù tàidù hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ zhège zhuān guì de xiāoshòu chéngjì shì zuì hǎo de.
examples.english: This skincare product is very suitable for people with dry skin, so its sales in the autumn and winter seasons are very good. Because the staff's service attitude is very good, this counter's sales performance is the best.

examples.chinese: 那個人喝了酒還開車，結果造成嚴重的車禍，害兩個人不幸死了，真可惡！
examples.pinyin: Nàge rén hē le jiǔ hái kāichē, jiéguǒ zàochéng yánzhòng de chēhuò, hài liǎng ge rén bùxìng sǐ le, zhēn kěwù!
examples.english: That person drank alcohol and still drove, resulting in a serious car accident that caused two people to die tragically; how detestable!

examples.chinese: 許經理有兩點值得我們學習，第一點是做事仔細，第二點是有耐心。你的白襯衫上面有一個黑點，快脫下來，我幫你洗一洗。
examples.pinyin: Xǔ jīnglǐ yǒu liǎng diǎn zhídé wǒmen xuéxí, dì yī diǎn shì zuòshì zǐxì, dì èr diǎn shì yǒu nàixīn. Nǐ de bái chènshān shàngmiàn yǒu yī gè hēi diǎn, kuài tuō xiàlái, wǒ bāng nǐ xǐ yī xǐ.
examples.english: Manager Xu has two points worth learning from: the first point is that he is careful in his work, and the second point is that he is patient. There is a black spot on your white shirt; quickly take it off, and I'll help you wash it.

examples.chinese: 簡老闆因為生意的關係，經常接觸越南人，相當了解兩國之間工作習慣的差異。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎn lǎobǎn yīnwèi shēngyì de guānxì, jīngcháng jiēchù Yuènánrén, xiāngdāng liǎojiě liǎng guó zhījiān gōngzuò xíguàn de chāyì.
examples.english: Boss Jian, because of business, frequently contacts Vietnamese people and quite understands the differences in working habits between the two countries.

examples.chinese: 老師把安養院社團的社員分成兩個小組，第一組陪老人唱歌， 第二組陪老人玩遊戲。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ ānyǎngyuàn shètuán de shèyuán fēnchéng liǎng ge xiǎozǔ, dì-yī zǔ péi lǎorén chànggē, dì-èr zǔ péi lǎorén wán yóuxì.
examples.english: The teacher divided the members of the nursing home club into two groups: the first group sang songs with the elderly, and the second group played games with the elderly.

examples.chinese: 我父親是個警察，只要他負責的小組有重要任務時，就得出差一兩個星期。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ fùqīn shì ge jǐngchá, zhǐyào tā fùzé de xiǎozǔ yǒu zhòngyào rènwu shí, jiù děi chūchāi yī liǎng ge xīngqī.
examples.english: My father is a police officer; whenever the team he is responsible for has an important task, he has to go on a business trip for one or two weeks.

examples.chinese: 這兩個國家因為搶石油資源，而把對方當成了敵人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge guójiā yīnwèi qiǎng shíyóu zīyuán, ér bǎ duìfāng dāngchéng le dírén.
examples.english: These two countries, because they are fighting over oil resources, have regarded each other as enemies.

examples.chinese: 阿姨的婚禮明天下午兩點在教堂舉行，這個重要時刻我一定不能遲到。
examples.pinyin: Āyí de hūnlǐ míngtiān xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn zài jiàotáng jǔxíng, zhège zhòngyào shíkè wǒ yīdìng bùnéng chídào.
examples.english: Auntie's wedding will be held at the church at two o'clock tomorrow afternoon; I absolutely must not be late for this important moment.

examples.chinese: 想當年，出國留學的日子雖然很忙，卻很充實。算算日子，剩下兩個星期經理就要退休了。明天是我父母結婚三十年的重要日子，一定要好好地慶祝。
examples.pinyin: 1. Xiǎng dāngnián, chūguó liúxué de rìzi suīrán hěn máng, què hěn chōngshí. 2. Suàn suàn rìzi, shèngxià liǎng ge xīngqī jīnglǐ jiù yào tuìxiū le. 3. Míngtiān shì wǒ fùmǔ jiéhūn sānshí nián de zhòngyào rìzi, yídìng yào hǎohǎo de qìngzhù.
examples.english: 1. Thinking back to those days, although the days of studying abroad were busy, they were very fulfilling. 2. Counting the days, there are only two weeks left before the manager retires. 3. Tomorrow is the important day of my parents' thirtieth wedding anniversary; we must celebrate it well.

examples.chinese: 這座古蹟已經有兩百多年的歷史。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò gǔjì yǐjīng yǒu liǎngbǎi duō nián de lìshǐ.
examples.english: This ancient relic already has a history of more than two hundred years.

examples.chinese: 張先生夫婦自從結婚以來，不曾吵過架，因為兩人的脾氣都太好了。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng fūfù zìcóng jiéhūn yǐlái, bùcéng chǎo guò jià, yīnwèi liǎng rén de píqi dōu tài hǎo le.
examples.english: Since Mr. and Mrs. Zhang got married, they have never had a fight, because both of their tempers are too good.

examples.chinese: 哥哥去超市買了一袋玉米和兩包麵條，要為家人準備晚餐。
examples.pinyin: Gēge qù chāoshì mǎi le yí dài yùmǐ hé liǎng bāo miàntiáo, yào wèi jiārén zhǔnbèi wǎncān.
examples.english: My older brother went to the supermarket and bought a bag of corn and two packs of noodles, to prepare dinner for the family.

examples.chinese: 這兩家公司在科技方面合作了很多年，也在科學雜誌上發表了共同的研究成果。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng jiā gōngsī zài kējì fāngmiàn hézuò le hěn duō nián, yě zài kēxué zázhì shàng fābiǎo le gòngtóng de yánjiū chéngguǒ.
examples.english: These two companies have cooperated in technology for many years and have also published mutual research results in science magazines.

examples.chinese: 小姐，我們要點兩碗牛肉麵和兩杯茶。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎojiě, wǒmen yào diǎn liǎng wǎn niúròu miàn hé liǎng bēi chá.
examples.english: Miss, we would like to order two bowls of beef noodles and two cups of tea.

examples.chinese: 請問兩位要紅茶還是綠茶？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn liǎng wèi yào hóngchá háishì lǜchá?
examples.english: Would you like to have black tea or green tea?

examples.chinese: 一共兩百一十五塊錢。
examples.pinyin: Yígòng liǎng bǎi yīshíwǔ kuài qián.
examples.english: It will be 215 dollars in total.

examples.chinese: 一共兩百多塊錢，好便宜！
examples.pinyin: Yígòng liǎng bǎi duō kuài qián, hǎo piányi!
examples.english: It is only a little over 200. It is cheap!

examples.chinese: 我們這個星期六下午兩點半去吧。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zhè ge xīngqí liù xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn bàn qù ba.
examples.english: Let’s go this Saturday at 2:30 p.m.

examples.chinese: 這兩天天氣有點兒冷，我們週末去，好嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng tiān tiānqì yǒudiǎnr lěng, wǒmen zhōumò qù, hǎo ma?
examples.english: It is a bit cold those two days. How about we do it this weekend?

examples.chinese: 這兩條我都去穿穿看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng tiáo wǒ dōu qù chuānchuān kàn.
examples.english: I will try both on.

examples.chinese: 爸爸每天早上一起床就看報紙。
examples.pinyin: Bàba měitiān zǎoshang yì qǐchuáng jiù kàn bàozhǐ.
examples.english: Every morning as soon as Dad gets out of bed, he reads the newspaper.

examples.chinese: 林伯伯透過網路、報紙，尋找三十年前因為戰爭而分開的家人，最後終於找到了。
examples.pinyin: Lín bóbo tòuguò wǎnglù, bàozhǐ, xúnzhǎo sānshí nián qián yīnwèi zhànzhēng ér fēnkāi de jiārén, zuìhòu zhōngyú zhǎodào le.
examples.english: Uncle Lin searched through the Internet and newspapers for family members separated thirty years ago because of war, and finally found them.

examples.chinese: 昨天老師教的日本歷史，你念了嗎？這個字我沒學過，怎麼唸？
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān lǎoshī jiāo de Rìběn lìshǐ, nǐ niàn le ma? Zhège zì wǒ méi xuéguò, zěnme niàn?
examples.english: Have you studied the Japanese history that the teacher taught yesterday? I haven't learned this character; how do you pronounce it?

examples.chinese: 念了一個小時的書以後，你最好休息十分鐘。
examples.pinyin: Niàn le yī ge xiǎoshí de shū yǐhòu, nǐ zuìhǎo xiūxi shí fēnzhōng.
examples.english: After studying for an hour, you had better rest for ten minutes.

examples.chinese: 我買了幾張當地的明信片，這些是這次旅行很好的紀念。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mǎile jǐ zhāng dāngdì de míngxìnpiàn, zhèxiē shì zhè cì lǚxíng hěn hǎo de jìniàn.
examples.english: I bought several local postcards; these are a very good souvenir of this trip.

examples.chinese: 這本中文書，我念到第四十三頁了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn Zhōngwén shū, wǒ niàn dào dì sìshísān yè le.
examples.english: I've read up to page 43 of this Chinese book.

examples.chinese: 你得多念一點兒書，將來才有能力當教授。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ děi duō niàn yīdiǎnr shū, jiānglái cái yǒu nénglì dāng jiàoshòu.
examples.english: You need to study a bit more, so that in the future you will have the ability to be a professor.

examples.chinese: 你得多念一點兒書，將來才有能力當教授。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ děi duō niàn yīdiǎnr shū, jiānglái cái yǒu nénglì dāng jiàoshòu.
examples.english: You need to study a bit more, so that in the future you will have the ability to be a professor.

examples.chinese: 畢業後要工作還是要繼續念書，我得好好地想想再選擇！
examples.pinyin: Bìyè hòu yào gōngzuò háishì yào jìxù niànshū, wǒ děi hǎohǎo de xiǎngxiang zài xuǎnzé!
examples.english: After graduation, whether to work or to continue studying, I must think it over carefully before choosing!

examples.chinese: 我的父母覺得出國念書才會有美好的未來。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de fùmǔ juéde chūguó niànshū cái huì yǒu měihǎo de wèilái.
examples.english: My parents think that only by studying abroad will you have a bright future.

examples.chinese: 王教授推薦我去念那個研究所的翻譯課程。
examples.pinyin: Wáng jiàoshòu tuījiàn wǒ qù niàn nàge yánjiūsuǒ de fānyì kèchéng.
examples.english: Professor Wang recommended that I go study the translation course at that graduate institute.

examples.chinese: 快考試了，這本書的前幾課我已經複習完了，可是沒時間念後三課。
examples.pinyin: Kuài kǎoshì le, zhè běn shū de qián jǐ kè wǒ yǐjīng fùxí wán le, kěshì méi shíjiān niàn hòu sān kè.
examples.english: The exam is coming soon—I've already finished reviewing the first few lessons of this book, but I don't have time to study the last three lessons.

examples.chinese: 快考試了，這本書的前幾課我已經複習完了，可是沒時間念後三課。
examples.pinyin: Kuài kǎoshì le, zhè běn shū de qián jǐ kè wǒ yǐjīng fùxí wán le, kěshì méi shíjiān niàn hòu sān kè.
examples.english: The exam is coming soon—I've already finished reviewing the first few lessons of this book, but I don't have time to study the last three lessons.

examples.chinese: 每個國家都有偉大的人物，值得大家紀念他們。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge guójiā dōu yǒu wěidà de rénwù, zhídé dàjiā jìniàn tāmen.
examples.english: Every country has great figures who are worth everyone commemorating.

examples.chinese: 每個國家都有偉大的人物，值得大家紀念他們。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge guójiā dōu yǒu wěidà de rénwù, zhídé dàjiā jìniàn tāmen.
examples.english: Every country has great figures who are worth everyone commemorating.

examples.chinese: 「教師節」這個節日是為了紀念偉大的孔子。
examples.pinyin: 「Jiàoshī Jié」 zhège jiérì shì wèile jìniàn wěidà de Kǒngzǐ.
examples.english: The holiday "Teachers' Day" is for commemorating the great Confucius.

examples.chinese: 小韓早晚都打工，是因為想多存一些錢，早一點完成出國念書的夢想。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Hán zǎowǎn dōu dǎgōng, shì yīnwèi xiǎng duō cún yìxiē qián, zǎo yìdiǎn wánchéng chūguó niànshū de mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: Xiao Han works part-time in the morning and evening because he wants to save more money and fulfill his dream of studying abroad earlier.

examples.chinese: 小簡向很多公司自我推薦，經過了幾個月，最後找到了滿意的工作。經過跟父母的討論，大中決定先出國遊學一年，再回來念大學。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Jiǎn xiàng hěn duō gōngsī zìwǒ tuījiàn, jīngguò le jǐ ge yuè, zuìhòu zhǎodào le mǎnyì de gōngzuò. Jīngguò gēn fùmǔ de tǎolùn, Dàzhōng juédìng xiān chūguó yóuxué yì nián, zài huílái niàn dàxué.
examples.english: Xiao Jian recommended himself to many companies; after several months, he finally found a satisfactory job. After discussing with his parents, Dazhong decided to first study abroad for a year, and then come back to attend university.

examples.chinese: 這個紀念堂是為了紀念那些為國家犧牲生命的軍人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jìniàntáng shì wèile jìniàn nàxiē wèi guójiā xīshēng shēngmìng de jūnrén.
examples.english: This memorial hall is to commemorate those soldiers who sacrificed their lives for the country.

examples.chinese: 張太太一個人管三個孩子，家裡大大小小的事情也是她負責的，太辛苦了。姊姊：下個星期就要大學考試了，你怎麼不用功念書，反而天天出去玩？ 弟弟：妳別管我，這是我自己的事。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng tàitai yī gè rén guǎn sān gè háizi, jiālǐ dàdàxiǎoxiǎo de shìqíng yě shì tā fùzé de, tài xīngkǔ le. Jiějie: Xià gè xīngqī jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, nǐ zěnme bù yònggōng niànshū, fǎn'ér tiāntiān chūqù wán? Dìdi: Nǐ bié guǎn wǒ, zhè shì wǒ zìjǐ de shì.
examples.english: Mrs. Zhang manages three children all by herself, and she is also responsible for all the big and small matters at home; it's too hard. Older sister: The university exam is next week; why aren't you studying hard, but instead going out to play every day? Younger brother: Don't manage me; this is my own business.

examples.chinese: 章先生念國小時，父親帶著他上山下海、到處旅遊，那是屬於他們的美好記憶。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng niàn guóxiǎo shí, fùqīn dàizhe tā shàngshān xiàhǎi, dàochù lǚyóu, nà shì shǔyú tāmen de měihǎo jìyì.
examples.english: When Mr. Zhang was in elementary school, his father took him up mountains and across seas, traveling everywhere; that is a beautiful memory belonging to them.

examples.chinese: 我的法國朋友最初只計畫來臺灣學中文，沒想到後來拿到了獎學金，還念了博士班。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de Fǎguó péngyǒu zuìchū zhǐ jìhuà lái Táiwān xué Zhōngwén, méi xiǎngdào hòulái nádàole jiǎngxuéjīn, hái niànle bóshìbān.
examples.english: At first, my French friend only planned to come to Taiwan to study Chinese; unexpectedly, later he received a scholarship and even studied in a doctoral program.

examples.chinese: 對華人來說，把書念好才有美好的未來，這個傳統觀念在臺灣已經慢慢改變了。
examples.pinyin: Duì Huárén lái shuō, bǎ shū niàn hǎo cái yǒu měihǎo de wèilái, zhège chuántǒng guānniàn zài Táiwān yǐjīng mànman gǎibiàn le.
examples.english: For Chinese people, only by studying well can one have a beautiful future; this traditional concept has already gradually changed in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 時代進步了，女人在家庭和社會中的地位也跟著提高了。在古代中國，男人不應該進廚房的傳統觀念，也因為時代的改變而不同。
examples.pinyin: Shídài jìnbù le, nǚrén zài jiātíng hé shèhuì zhōng de dìwèi yě gēnzhe tígāo le. Zài gǔdài Zhōngguó, nánrén bù yīnggāi jìn chúfáng de chuántǒng guānniàn, yě yīnwèi shídài de gǎibiàn ér bùtóng.
examples.english: Times have progressed, and women's status in the family and society has risen accordingly. In ancient China, the traditional concept that men should not enter the kitchen has also changed with the times.

examples.chinese: 孩子是父母最珍貴的寶貝，父母對他們的愛也是最真實的。小文房內的櫃子裡擺了很多寶貝，都是他上山下海帶回來的紀念品。
examples.pinyin: 1. Háizi shì fùmǔ zuì zhēnguì de bǎobèi, fùmǔ duì tāmen de ài yě shì zuì zhēnshí de. 2. Xiǎo Wén fángnèi de guìzi lǐ bǎi le hěn duō bǎobèi, dōu shì tā shàngshān xiàhǎi dài huílái de jìniànpǐn.
examples.english: 1. Children are their parents' most precious treasures, and parents' love for them is also the most genuine. 2. In the cabinet in Little Wen's room, there are many treasures displayed, all souvenirs he brought back from climbing mountains and exploring the seas.

examples.chinese: 快時尚的概念，就是在短時間內提供各式各樣的流行商品，讓顧客有更多更好的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Kuài shíshàng de gàiniàn, jiùshì zài duǎn shíjiān nèi tígōng gè shì gè yàng de liúxíng shāngpǐn, ràng gùkè yǒu gèng duō gèng hǎo de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: The concept of fast fashion is to provide a variety of trendy products in a short time, giving customers more and better choices.

examples.chinese: 到新公司報到以前，應先把個人的態度及觀念調整好。
examples.pinyin: Dào xīn gōngsī bàodào yǐqián, yīng xiān bǎ gèrén de tàidù jí guānniàn tiáozhěng hǎo.
examples.english: Before reporting for duty at a new company, you should first adjust your personal attitude and mindset well.

examples.chinese: 這幾箱書都是我念過的課本跟參考資料，打算送給育幼院的孩子。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jǐ xiāng shū dōu shì wǒ niàn guò de kèběn gēn cānkǎo zīliào, dǎsuàn sòng gěi yùyòuyuàn de háizi.
examples.english: These few boxes of books are all textbooks and reference materials I've studied; I plan to give them to the children at the orphanage.

examples.chinese: 以前我的小學老師總是親切地教導我們，讓我到現在還是很懷念她。
examples.pinyin: Yǐqián wǒ de xiǎoxué lǎoshī zǒngshì qīnqiè de jiàodǎo wǒmen, ràng wǒ dào xiànzài háishì hěn huáiniàn tā.
examples.english: My elementary school teacher used to teach us kindly, which makes me still cherish her memory even now.

examples.chinese: 他的中文能力已達到相當好的水準，在臺灣念研究所沒問題。
examples.pinyin: Tā de Zhōngwén nénglì yǐ dádào xiāngdāng hǎo de shuǐzhǔn, zài Táiwān niàn yánjiūsuǒ méi wèntí.
examples.english: His Chinese ability has already reached a fairly good level; studying at a graduate school in Taiwan is no problem.

examples.chinese: 按照中國的傳統觀念，女人未嫁時得聽父親的話，嫁了人之後就得聽丈夫的。
examples.pinyin: Ànzhào Zhōngguó de chuántǒng guānniàn, nǚrén wèi jià shí děi tīng fùqīn de huà, jià le rén zhīhòu jiù děi tīng zhàngfu de.
examples.english: According to traditional Chinese concepts, before a woman marries she must listen to her father's words, and after she marries she must listen to her husband's.

examples.chinese: 幸福的婚姻不僅需要觀念的溝通，更需要感情的交流。
examples.pinyin: Xìngfú de hūnyīn bùjǐn xūyào guānniàn de gōutōng, gèng xūyào gǎnqíng de jiāoliú.
examples.english: A happy marriage not only requires communication of ideas but even more requires an exchange of feelings.

examples.chinese: 紀念郵票一般都是以歷史上的大事或重要人物當作主題。
examples.pinyin: Jìniàn yóupiào yībān dōu shì yǐ lìshǐ shàng de dàshì huò zhòngyào rénwù dàngzuò zhǔtí.
examples.english: Commemorative stamps generally use major historical events or important figures as their themes.

examples.chinese: 這次畢業典禮，學校打算採用空拍的方式來拍紀念影片。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì bìyè diǎnlǐ, xuéxiào dǎsuàn cǎiyòng kōngpāi de fāngshì lái pāi jìniàn yǐngpiàn.
examples.english: For this graduation ceremony, the school plans to use aerial photography to shoot a commemorative video.

examples.chinese: 這個字不好念，我重複了好幾次，同學都說不對，害我好想放棄。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zì bù hǎo niàn, wǒ chóngfù le hǎo jǐ cì, tóngxué dōu shuō bù duì, hài wǒ hǎo xiǎng fàngqì.
examples.english: This character is hard to pronounce; I repeated it several times, and my classmates all said it was wrong, which made me really want to give up.

examples.chinese: 他想等中文程度達到高級以後，就來臺灣念大學。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng děng Zhōngwén chéngdù dádào gāojí yǐhòu, jiù lái Táiwān niàn dàxué.
examples.english: He wants to wait until his Chinese proficiency reaches the advanced level, and then come to Taiwan to attend university.

examples.chinese: 從過去到現在，尊敬長輩一直是華人最重視的傳統觀念之一。
examples.pinyin: Cóng guòqù dào xiànzài, zūnjìng zhǎngbèi yīzhí shì Huárén zuì zhòngshì de chuántǒng guānniàn zhī yī.
examples.english: From the past to the present, respecting elders has always been one of the traditional values that Chinese people value most.

examples.chinese: 在觀光景點銷售紀念品，價格通常比一般商店高一些。
examples.pinyin: Zài guānguāng jǐngdiǎn xiāoshòu jìniànpǐn, jiàgé tōngcháng bǐ yībān shāngdiàn gāo yīxiē.
examples.english: Souvenirs sold at tourist attractions are usually a bit more expensive than those in regular stores.

examples.chinese: 難得出國旅行，一定要多照幾張相片留念。
examples.pinyin: Nándé chūguó lǚxíng, yīdìng yào duō zhào jǐ zhāng xiàngpiàn liúniàn.
examples.english: It is rare to travel abroad, so you must take a few more photos to keep as souvenirs.

examples.chinese: 這座圓形廣場是為了紀念自由而建的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò yuánxíng guǎngchǎng shì wèile jìniàn zìyóu ér jiàn de.
examples.english: This circular plaza was built to commemorate freedom.

items.wordHook: A 今(now) over a 心(heart) means your thoughts stay in the present → 念(think of).

examples.chinese: 聽到那首歌，讓李小姐哭得很傷心。
examples.pinyin: Tīngdào nà shǒu gē, ràng Lǐ xiǎojiě kū de hěn shāngxīn.
examples.english: Hearing that song made Miss Li cry very sadly.

examples.chinese: 那個小孩一看到大狗，就嚇得哭起來了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎohái yí kàn dào dà gǒu, jiù xià de kū qǐlái le.
examples.english: As soon as that child saw the big dog, he was so scared that he started crying.

examples.chinese: 鞭炮的聲音很可怕，把孩子嚇得哭起來了。等半夜十二點的鐘聲一響，我們就要放鞭炮慶祝新年了。
examples.pinyin: 1. Biānpào de shēngyīn hěn kěpà, bǎ háizi xià de kū qǐlái le. 2. Děng bànyè shí'èr diǎn de zhōngshēng yì xiǎng, wǒmen jiù yào fàng biānpào qìngzhù xīnnián le.
examples.english: 1. The sound of firecrackers is very scary; it scared the child to tears. 2. When the midnight bell rings at twelve o'clock, we will set off firecrackers to celebrate the New Year.

examples.chinese: 鞭炮的聲音很可怕，把孩子嚇得哭起來了。等半夜十二點的鐘聲一響，我們就要放鞭炮慶祝新年了。
examples.pinyin: 1. Biānpào de shēngyīn hěn kěpà, bǎ háizi xià de kū qǐlái le. 2. Děng bànyè shí'èr diǎn de zhōngshēng yì xiǎng, wǒmen jiù yào fàng biānpào qìngzhù xīnnián le.
examples.english: 1. The sound of firecrackers is very scary; it scared the child to tears. 2. When the midnight bell rings at twelve o'clock, we will set off firecrackers to celebrate the New Year.

examples.chinese: 妹妹知道自己考上了最好的研究所，激動地哭了起來。
examples.pinyin: Mèimei zhīdào zìjǐ kǎo shàng le zuì hǎo de yánjiūsuǒ, jīdòng de kū le qǐlái.
examples.english: When my younger sister learned that she had gotten into the best graduate school, she was so excited that she started crying.

examples.chinese: 我記得第一次出國讀書時，因為不習慣和家人分開，常常半夜哭著打電話回家。那對情侶因為不了解而在一起，沒想到最後因為了解而分開。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìde dì yī cì chūguó dúshū shí, yīnwèi bù xíguàn hé jiārén fēnkāi, chángcháng bànyè kūzhe dǎ diànhuà huí jiā. Nà duì qínglǚ yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér zài yīqǐ, méi xiǎngdào zuìhòu yīnwèi liǎojiě ér fēnkāi.
examples.english: I remember when I first went abroad to study, because I wasn't used to being separated from my family, I often cried on the phone at midnight. That couple got together because they didn't understand each other, but unexpectedly in the end they separated because they understood each other.

examples.chinese: 有的小朋友很討厭打針，一看見護理師拿針筒(medical syringe)的樣子就哭了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒude xiǎopéngyǒu hěn tǎoyàn dǎzhēn, yī kànjiàn hùlǐshī ná zhēntǒng de yàngzi jiù kū le.
examples.english: Some children really hate getting injections; as soon as they see the nurse holding a syringe, they cry.

examples.chinese: 為了使市區（shìqū， urban area）的交通更便利，目前黃市長正進行各種改善計畫。
examples.pinyin: Wèile shǐ shìqū de jiāotōng gèng biànlì, mùqián Huáng shìzhǎng zhèng jìnxíng gè zhǒng gǎishàn jìhuà.
examples.english: In order to make traffic in the urban area more convenient, right now Mayor Huang is proceeding with various improvement plans.

examples.chinese: 科學家早就證明了氣溫的變化對農業生產有不好的影響，可是到目前還找不到解決的好辦法。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā zǎo jiù zhèngmíng le qìwēn de biànhuà duì nóngyè shēngchǎn yǒu bù hǎo de yǐngxiǎng, kěshì dào mùqián hái zhǎo bú dào jiějué de hǎo bànfǎ.
examples.english: Scientists proved long ago that temperature changes have a bad effect on agricultural production, but up to now they still cannot find a good solution.

examples.chinese: 根據目前科學研究的資料，女性與男性在能力、態度和行為等方面的差異都非常小。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù mùqián kēxué yánjiū de zīliào, nǚxìng yǔ nánxìng zài nénglì, tàidù hé xíngwéi děng fāngmiàn de chāyì dōu fēicháng xiǎo.
examples.english: According to current scientific research data, the differences between women and men in aspects such as ability, attitude, and behavior are all very small.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，目前已被發現的蝴蝶大約有三百七十種以上。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, mùqián yǐ bèi fāxiàn de húdié dàyuē yǒu sānbǎi qīshí zhǒng yǐshàng.
examples.english: In Taiwan, the butterflies that have been discovered so far number approximately over 370 species.

examples.chinese: 這位著名畫家的作品，目前正在美術館展出。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zhùmíng huàjiā de zuòpǐn, mùqián zhèngzài měishùguǎn zhǎnchū.
examples.english: This famous painter's works are currently on display at the art museum.

examples.chinese: 雕刻玉器的技術很複雜，目前多半還是只能靠人工處理。
examples.pinyin: Diāokè yùqì de jìshù hěn fùzá, mùqián duōbàn háishì zhǐ néng kào réngōng chǔlǐ.
examples.english: The technique of carving jade is very complex; at present, most of it can still only be handled by hand.

items.wordHook: Combining 目(eye) and 前(front): 目前 means right now.

examples.chinese: 註了冊以後，新生要把相關證件各影印一份，交給學校。
examples.pinyin: Zhù le cè yǐhòu, xīnshēng yào bǎ xiāngguān zhèngjiàn gè yǐngyìn yī fèn, jiāo gěi xuéxiào.
examples.english: After registering, new students must photocopy one copy of each relevant document and submit them to the school.

examples.chinese: 根據車禍調查的結果，保險公司及對方應各賠我十萬元。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù chēhuò diàochá de jiéguǒ, bǎoxiǎn gōngsī jí duìfāng yīng gè péi wǒ shí wàn yuán.
examples.english: According to the results of the car accident investigation, the insurance company and the other party should each compensate me one hundred thousand dollars.

examples.chinese: 那輛腳踏車對個子小的我來說太高了，腳很難跨過去。我們大學前年起已開放跨校選課，增加各校的交流機會。
examples.pinyin: Nà liàng jiǎotàchē duì gèzi xiǎo de wǒ lái shuō tài gāo le, jiǎo hěn nán kuà guòqù. Wǒmen dàxué qiánnián qǐ yǐ kāifàng kuàxiào xuǎnkè, zēngjiā gè xiào de jiāoliú jīhuì.
examples.english: That bicycle is too high for me, since I'm short, so it's hard to straddle my leg over it. Our university has offered cross-school course selection since the year before last, increasing opportunities for exchange between schools.

examples.chinese: 我心中有兩個夢想，一是當歌星，另一個是去各國旅行。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xīn zhōng yǒu liǎng ge mèngxiǎng, yī shì dāng gēxīng, lìng yí ge shì qù gè guó lǚxíng.
examples.english: I have two dreams in my heart: one is to become a singer, and the other is to travel to various countries.

examples.chinese: 叔叔時常跟我聊他到世界各地旅行的故事，真是有意思。
examples.pinyin: Shūshu shícháng gēn wǒ liáo tā dào shìjiè gèdì lǚxíng de gùshì, zhēn shì yǒu yìsi.
examples.english: My uncle often chats with me about his stories of traveling around the world; it's really interesting.

examples.chinese: 元宵節時公園裡點起各式各樣的燈籠，各種顏色的燈光漂亮極了。
examples.pinyin: Yuánxiāojié shí gōngyuán lǐ diǎn qǐ gè shì gè yàng de dēnglóng, gè zhǒng yánsè de dēngguāng piàoliang jí le.
examples.english: During the Lantern Festival, various lanterns are lit in the park; the lights of all colors are extremely beautiful.

examples.chinese: 快時尚的概念，就是在短時間內提供各式各樣的流行商品，讓顧客有更多更好的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Kuài shíshàng de gàiniàn, jiùshì zài duǎn shíjiān nèi tígōng gè shì gè yàng de liúxíng shāngpǐn, ràng gùkè yǒu gèng duō gèng hǎo de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: The concept of fast fashion is to provide a variety of trendy products in a short time, giving customers more and better choices.

examples.chinese: 科學家發明了電燈，改變了人類的生活方式，也大大提高了生活品質。網路是很偉大的發明，就算不出門，也能讓人們得到全球各地的訊息。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā fāmíng le diàndēng, gǎibiàn le rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì, yě dàdà tígāo le shēnghuó pǐnzhí. Wǎnglù shì hěn wěidà de fāmíng, jiùsuàn bù chūmén, yě néng ràng rénmen dédào quánqiú gèdì de xùnxí.
examples.english: Scientists invented the electric light, which changed the lifestyle of mankind and also greatly improved the quality of life. The Internet is a great invention; even without going out, it can let people get information from all over the world.

examples.chinese: 為了使市區（shìqū， urban area）的交通更便利，目前黃市長正進行各種改善計畫。
examples.pinyin: Wèile shǐ shìqū de jiāotōng gèng biànlì, mùqián Huáng shìzhǎng zhèng jìnxíng gè zhǒng gǎishàn jìhuà.
examples.english: In order to make traffic in the urban area more convenient, right now Mayor Huang is proceeding with various improvement plans.

examples.chinese: 網路商店滿足了人們購物的需求，就是不出門，也可買到各式各樣的生活用品。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù shāngdiàn mǎnzú le rénmen gòuwù de xūqiú, jiùshì bù chūmén, yě kě mǎi dào gè shì gè yàng de shēnghuó yòngpǐn.
examples.english: Online stores have satisfied people's shopping needs; even without leaving home, you can buy all kinds of daily necessities.

examples.chinese: 史教授為了讓更多人了解保護地球環境有多重要，經常到各地去演講。
examples.pinyin: Shǐ jiàoshòu wèi le ràng gèng duō rén liǎojiě bǎohù dìqiú huánjìng yǒu duō zhòngyào, jīngcháng dào gèdì qù yǎnjiǎng.
examples.english: In order to let more people understand how important it is to protect the Earth's environment, Professor Shi often goes to various places to give speeches.

examples.chinese: 明天的會議資料我已經上傳到雲端，請各位開會前先了解要討論的內容。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān de huìyì zīliào wǒ yǐjīng shàngchuán dào yúnduān, qǐng gèwèi kāihuì qián xiān liǎojiě yào tǎolùn de nèiróng.
examples.english: I have already uploaded tomorrow's meeting materials to the cloud; please understand the content to be discussed before the meeting.

examples.chinese: 公司的會議資料都存在雲端，這樣又安全又方便，各部門也能隨時參考。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī de huìyì zīliào dōu cún zài yúnduān, zhèyàng yòu ānquán yòu fāngbiàn, gè bùmén yě néng suíshí cānkǎo.
examples.english: The company's meeting materials are all stored in the cloud; this way it is both safe and convenient, and each department can also refer to them at any time.

examples.chinese: 這次亞洲文化展，除了樂器表演，還有傳統服裝試穿活動，歡迎各位來參觀。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì Yàzhōu wénhuà zhǎn, chúle yuèqì biǎoyǎn, hái yǒu chuántǒng fúzhuāng shìchuān huódòng, huānyíng gèwèi lái cānguān.
examples.english: This Asian Culture Exhibition, in addition to musical instrument performances, also has traditional clothing try-on activities; everyone is welcome to visit.

examples.chinese: 現代各式各樣的科技產品，讓人們的生活更舒適、便利。這家旅館每個房間都設計得很現代，吸引不少年輕人來訂房。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài gè shì gè yàng de kējì chǎnpǐn, ràng rénmen de shēnghuó gèng shūshì, biànlì. Zhè jiā lǚguǎn měi gè fángjiān dōu shèjì de hěn xiàndài, xīyǐn bù shǎo niánqīngrén lái dìng fáng.
examples.english: Modern various technological products make people's lives more comfortable and convenient. This hotel's rooms are all designed in a very modern way, attracting many young people to book rooms.

examples.chinese: 明天要考五科，每科的測驗題目各有五十題，我想今天晚上得開夜車了。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān yào kǎo wǔ kē, měi kē de cèyàn tímù gè yǒu wǔshí tí, wǒ xiǎng jīntiān wǎnshang děi kāi yèchē le.
examples.english: Tomorrow I have exams in five subjects; each subject has fifty test questions, so I think tonight I'll have to burn the midnight oil.

examples.chinese: 這個教材比較難，老師怕學生不容易吸收，因此利用各種教學工具來幫助學生學習。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jiàocái bǐjiào nán, lǎoshī pà xuéshēng bù róngyì xīshōu, yīncǐ lìyòng gè zhǒng jiàoxué gōngjù lái bāngzhù xuéshēng xuéxí.
examples.english: This textbook is rather difficult; the teacher was afraid students wouldn't easily absorb it, therefore used various teaching tools to help students learn.

examples.chinese: 這堂課的內容跟文化有關，所以老師把教學重心放在介紹各國的文化特色。
examples.pinyin: Zhè táng kè de nèiróng gēn wénhuà yǒuguān, suǒyǐ lǎoshī bǎ jiàoxué zhòngxīn fàng zài jièshào gè guó de wénhuà tèsè.
examples.english: The content of this class is related to culture, so the teacher put the teaching focus on introducing the cultural characteristics of various countries.

examples.chinese: 這次地震的規模很大，連總統一時也很難掌握各地的災情。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì dìzhèn de guīmó hěn dà, lián zǒngtǒng yīshí yě hěn nán zhǎngwò gèdì de zāiqíng.
examples.english: The scale of this earthquake was very large; even the president had difficulty grasping the disaster situation in various places for a while.

examples.chinese: 臺灣南部不僅天氣好、旅遊景點多，還有各式各樣的傳統小吃，很值得去走走。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān nánbù bùjǐn tiānqì hǎo, lǚyóu jǐngdiǎn duō, hái yǒu gè shì gè yàng de chuántǒng xiǎochī, hěn zhídé qù zǒuzǒu.
examples.english: Southern Taiwan not only has good weather and many touring spots, but also has all kinds of traditional snacks; it's well worth a visit.

examples.chinese: 春天來了，天氣變暖和了，院子裡開了各種顏色的花，給人帶來一種新的希望。
examples.pinyin: Chūntiān lái le, tiānqì biàn nuǎnhuo le, yuànzi lǐ kāi le gè zhǒng yánsè de huā, gěi rén dàilái yī zhǒng xīn de xīwàng.
examples.english: Spring has come, the weather has become warmer, and flowers of various colors have blossomed in the yard, bringing people a new kind of hope.

examples.chinese: 這次的電腦展集合了各國有名的牌子，很值得參觀。老師要帶我們去參觀博物館，明天早上九點在校門口集合。
examples.pinyin: 1. Zhè cì de diànnǎo zhǎn jíhé le gè guó yǒumíng de páizi, hěn zhídé cānguān. 2. Lǎoshī yào dài wǒmen qù cānguān bówùguǎn, míngtiān zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn zài xiàoménkǒu jíhé.
examples.english: 1. This computer exhibition gathered famous brands from various countries and is well worth visiting. 2. The teacher is taking us to visit the museum; we will gather at the school gate at 9 a.m. tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 公司進了各式各樣的健身機器， 我們得好好利用這些機器，訓練自己的體力。美美剛進模特兒公司時，有一位導演找她演戲，沒想到就讓她變成了有名的明星。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jìn le gèshì-gèyàng de jiànshēn jīqì, wǒmen děi hǎohǎo lìyòng zhèxiē jīqì, xùnliàn zìjǐ de tǐlì. Měiměi gāng jìn mótè'ér gōngsī shí, yǒu yí wèi dǎoyǎn zhǎo tā yǎn xì, méi xiǎngdào jiù ràng tā biàn chéng le yǒumíng de míngxīng.
examples.english: The company purchased various kinds of fitness machines; we must make good use of these machines to train our physical strength. When Meimei first entered the modeling agency, a director asked her to act in a show; unexpectedly, it made her a famous star.

examples.chinese: 台灣有各式各樣的小吃，其中最吸引我的是蚵仔煎。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān yǒu gèshìgèyàng de xiǎochī, qízhōng zuì xīyǐn wǒ de shì kēzǎijiān.
examples.english: Taiwan has all kinds of snacks, among which the one that attracts me most is oyster omelet.

examples.chinese: 台灣的夜市很有特色，除了有各式各樣的小吃，還有不少好玩的遊戲。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de yèshì hěn yǒu tèsè, chúle yǒu gèshìgèyàng de xiǎochī, hái yǒu bùshǎo hǎowán de yóuxì.
examples.english: Taiwan's night markets are very distinctive; besides having various snacks, there are also quite a few fun games.

examples.chinese: 夜市裡有各種小吃和飲料。
examples.pinyin: Yèshì lǐ yǒu gè zhǒng xiǎochī hé yǐnliào.
examples.english: In the night market, there are various kinds of snacks and drinks.

examples.chinese: 在歐洲，小麥做的各種食品常被當作餐桌上的主要食物。
examples.pinyin: Zài Ōuzhōu, xiǎomài zuò de gè zhǒng shípǐn cháng bèi dàngzuò cānzhuō shàng de zhǔyào shíwù.
examples.english: In Europe, various foods made from wheat are often regarded as the main food on the dining table.

examples.chinese: 地球氣溫越來越高，世界各地氣候的變化也越來越明顯。
examples.pinyin: Dìqiú qìwēn yuè lái yuè gāo, shìjiè gèdì qìhòu de biànhuà yě yuè lái yuè míngxiǎn.
examples.english: The Earth’s temperature is getting higher and higher, and climate changes around the world are also becoming more and more obvious.

examples.chinese: 教授的房間堆滿了各種書籍，本來就不大的房間感覺更擠了。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshòu de fángjiān duī mǎn le gè zhǒng shūjí, běnlái jiù bù dà de fángjiān gǎnjué gèng jǐ le.
examples.english: The professor's room is piled full of all kinds of books; the room, which wasn't big to begin with, feels even more crowded.

examples.chinese: 政府最主要的任務應是維持並保護社會安全，其次是規畫各種制度，使國家穩定地成長。
examples.pinyin: Zhèngfǔ zuì zhǔyào de rènwu yīng shì wéichí bìng bǎohù shèhuì ānquán, qícì shì guīhuà gè zhǒng zhìdù, shǐ guójiā wěndìng de chéngzhǎng.
examples.english: The government's most main task should be to maintain and protect social security; next is to plan various systems so that the country can grow stably.

examples.chinese: 他很喜歡買文具，尤其是筆，各國進口的原子筆他都有。
examples.pinyin: Tā hěn xǐhuān mǎi wénjù, yóuqí shì bǐ, gè guó jìnkǒu de yuánzǐbǐ tā dōu yǒu.
examples.english: He really likes buying stationery, especially pens; he has ballpoint pens imported from various countries.

examples.chinese: 他迷上足球，所以買了各式各樣的足球鞋。
examples.pinyin: Tā mí shàng zúqiú, suǒyǐ mǎi le gè shì gè yàng de zúqiú xié.
examples.english: He is fascinated by soccer, so he bought all kinds of soccer shoes.

examples.chinese: 他從音樂學院畢業以後就加入歌劇團，到世界各地表演。
examples.pinyin: Tā cóng yīnyuè xuéyuàn bìyè yǐhòu jiù jiārù gējùtuán, dào shìjiè gèdì biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: After graduating from the music conservatory, he joined an opera troupe and performed all over the world.

examples.chinese: 網路直播的內容各種各樣，甚至有人因為直播平日生活而變成明星。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù zhíbō de nèiróng gèzhǒng-gèyàng, shènzhì yǒu rén yīnwèi zhíbō píngrì shēnghuó ér biànchéng míngxīng.
examples.english: The content of live internet broadcasts is all kinds of things; some people even become stars because they live-broadcast their everyday life.

examples.chinese: 參加旅行團或自助旅遊各有各的優點，懶得自己安排行程的人，就跟著導遊走吧。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā lǚxíngtuán huò zìzhù lǚyóu gè yǒu gè de yōudiǎn, lǎn de zìjǐ ānpái xíngchéng de rén, jiù gēnzhe dǎoyóu zǒu ba.
examples.english: Joining a tour group or traveling independently each has its own advantages; those who are too lazy to arrange their own itinerary should just follow the tour guide.

examples.chinese: 這個城市夜晚因各種各樣的彩色燈光，而使得景色既浪漫又迷人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège chéngshì yèwǎn yīn gè zhǒng gè yàng de cǎisè dēngguāng, ér shǐde jǐngsè jì làngmàn yòu mírén.
examples.english: At night, this city, because of various colorful lights, makes the scenery both romantic and charming.

examples.chinese: 大自然除了有各種動植物，還有山地、平原、河流等等，這一切應該是上帝創造的。
examples.pinyin: Dàzìrán chúle yǒu gè zhǒng dòngzhíwù, hái yǒu shāndì, píngyuán, héliú děngděng, zhè yíqiè yīnggāi shì Shàngdì chuàngzào de.
examples.english: In addition to having various animals and plants, nature also has mountains, plains, rivers, and so on; all of this was presumably created by God.

examples.chinese: 我夢想有一天可以到世界各地旅行。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ mèngxiǎng yǒu yìtiān kěyǐ dào shìjiè gèdì lǚxíng.
examples.english: I dream of one day being able to travel to all parts of the world.

examples.chinese: 這條街道旁有各式各樣的商店與餐廳，假日時相當熱鬧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo jiēdào páng yǒu gèshìgèyàng de shāngdiàn yǔ cāntīng, jiàrì shí xiāngdāng rènao.
examples.english: Along this street there are all kinds of shops and restaurants; on holidays it is quite bustling.

examples.chinese: 我對人體各部分的功能很有興趣，不過我沒想過當醫生。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ duì réntǐ gè bùfèn de gōngnéng hěn yǒu xìngqù, bùguò wǒ méi xiǎngguò dāng yīshēng.
examples.english: I'm very interested in the functions of the various parts of the human body, but I've never thought about becoming a doctor.

examples.chinese: 新員工在經過專門的訓練後，都已能使用工廠各種生產機器。
examples.pinyin: Xīn yuángōng zài jīngguò zhuānmén de xùnliàn hòu, dōu yǐ néng shǐyòng gōngchǎng gè zhǒng shēngchǎn jīqì.
examples.english: After receiving specialized training, the new employees are all now able to use the various production machines in the factory.

examples.chinese: 我們應該培養獨立思考的能力，別被身邊各種訊息左右。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yīnggāi péiyǎng dúlì sīkǎo de nénglì, bié bèi shēnbiān gèzhǒng xùnxī zuǒyòu.
examples.english: We should cultivate the ability to think independently; don't be controlled by all kinds of information around you.

examples.chinese: 這次座談會邀請了各領域的人們，主要目的是對國內的地方建設提一些建議。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì zuòtánhuì yāoqǐng le gè lǐngyù de rénmen, zhǔyào mùdì shì duì guónèi de dìfāng jiànshè tí yìxiē jiànyì.
examples.english: This forum invited people from various fields; its main purpose is to offer some suggestions for domestic local construction.

examples.chinese: 個人在使用各式各樣的網路服務時，也應該注意隱私問題。
examples.pinyin: Gèrén zài shǐyòng gè shì gè yàng de wǎnglù fúwù shí, yě yīnggāi zhùyì yǐnsī wèntí.
examples.english: When individuals use various kinds of internet services, they should also pay attention to privacy issues.

examples.chinese: 他想寫一本以各行各業人物當作題材的長篇小說。
examples.pinyin: Tā xiǎng xiě yī běn yǐ gègèhánggèyè rénwù dāngzuò tícái de chángpiān xiǎoshuō.
examples.english: He wants to write a full-length novel that uses people from all walks of life as its subject matter.

examples.chinese: 各行各業都有屬於自己的專業，無法比較誰高誰低。
examples.pinyin: Gè háng gè yè dōu yǒu shǔyú zìjǐ de zhuānyè, wúfǎ bǐjiào shéi gāo shéi dī.
examples.english: Every profession has its own specialty; it is impossible to compare who is higher and who is lower.

examples.chinese: 企業為了錄用合適的人才，而採用各式各樣的方式。
examples.pinyin: Qǐyè wèile lùyòng héshì de réncái, ér cǎiyòng gè shì gè yàng de fāngshì.
examples.english: Enterprises adopt various methods in order to hire suitable talent.

examples.chinese: 世界各地的神話雖然不見得都真實，卻能讓人們多少了解一些古代的風俗習慣。
examples.pinyin: Shìjiè gèdì de shénhuà suīrán bú jiàndé dōu zhēnshí, què néng ràng rénmen duōshǎo liǎojiě yīxiē gǔdài de fēngsú xíguàn.
examples.english: Although myths from around the world are not necessarily all true, they can still let people understand some ancient customs and habits to some extent.

examples.chinese: 雖然他已經親自說了對不起，但還是很後悔做出那樣沒禮貌的行為，於是再度向各位道歉。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán tā yǐjīng qīnzì shuō le duìbuqǐ, dàn háishì hěn hòuhuǐ zuòchū nàyàng méi lǐmào de xíngwéi, yúshì zàidù xiàng gèwèi dàoqiàn.
examples.english: Although he has already personally said sorry, he still very much regrets having behaved so impolitely, so he once again apologizes to everyone.

examples.chinese: 學校餐廳提供各式各樣的營養食品，供學生挑選。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào cāntīng tígōng gè shì gè yàng de yíngyǎng shípǐn, gōng xuéshēng tiāoxuǎn.
examples.english: The school cafeteria provides a variety of nutritious foods for students to choose from.

examples.chinese: 電腦工程師除了維護電腦，還要處理各種與電腦相關的問題。
examples.pinyin: Diànnǎo gōngchéngshī chúle wéihù diànnǎo, hái yào chǔlǐ gèzhǒng yǔ diànnǎo xiāngguān de wèntí.
examples.english: Computer engineers, in addition to maintaining computers, also have to handle various computer-related problems.

items.wordHook: Each 夂(go) takes its own 口(mouth) along → 各(individual).

examples.chinese: 你放餅乾盒的時候輕一點兒，餅乾碎了就不好吃、不好拿了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ fàng bǐnggān hé de shíhou qīng yīdiǎnr, bǐnggān suì le jiù bù hǎochī, bù hǎo ná le.
examples.english: When you put down the cookie box, be a bit gentler; if the cookies break into pieces, they won't taste good and won't be easy to pick up.

examples.chinese: 為了發展個人事業而放下學業，多數人是很難做到的。
examples.pinyin: Wèile fāzhǎn gèrén shìyè ér fàngxià xuéyè, duōshù rén shì hěn nán zuòdào de.
examples.english: To give up one's studies in order to develop a personal career is something most people find very hard to do.

examples.chinese: 冰箱裡的牛奶早就過期了，你還不扔掉嗎？
examples.pinyin: Bīngxiāng lǐ de niúnǎi zǎo jiù guòqī le, nǐ hái bù rēngdiào ma?
examples.english: The milk in the fridge expired long ago—aren't you going to throw it away yet?

examples.chinese: 我剛拖了地，地上還是溼的，你最好繞過去比較安全。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng tuō le dì, dìshàng háishì shī de, nǐ zuìhǎo rào guòqù bǐjiào ānquán.
examples.english: I just mopped the floor, and the floor is still wet; you'd better go around it, it's safer.

items.wordHook: 地(earth/place) + 址(location) → the place where you are, your address.
To 帶(belt) a 來(arrive): 帶來 means bring.
